heading: Park/Neutral Position (Pnp)
text:
AX-8
AUTOMATIC TRANSAXLE (U240E) - PARK/NEUTRAL POSITION (PNP) SWITCH
PARK/NEUTRAL POSITION (PNP)
SWITCH
ON-VEHICLE REPAIR
1. REMOVE AIR CLEANER ASSEMBLY
2. DISCONNECT PARK/NEUTRAL POSITION SWITCH
CONNECTOR
3. REMOVE PARK/NEUTRAL POSITION SWITCH
(a) Remove the nut.
p
{b) Remove the nut, washer and control shift lever.
p
(c) Using a screwdriver. pry off the lock plate.
(d) Remove the nut and lock plate.m
(e) Remove the 2 bolts and pull out the park/neutral position
switch.
4. INSTALL AND ADJUST PARK/NEUTRAL POSITION
SWITCH
(a} Install the park/neutral position switch with the 2 bolts.
Torque: 5.4 N•m (55 kgf.cm, 48 in.-lbf)
{b) Install a new lock plate and nut.
Torque: 6.9 N-m (70 kgf.cm, 61 in.-lbf)
r (c) Bend the claws on the lock plate to fix the nut.
